full.en: FATBURN TEA, 120 g - Instant tea blend, guarana and elderberry contribute to fat metabolism, eliminate overweight andsuppressesfeelingofhunger.Ingredients:instantteablend (tapioca starch, white tea extract (5%), vitamin C (ascorbic acid)), forest fruit flavor, elderberry extract (Sambucus nigra l. ), guarana extract (Paullinia cupana Kunth). Using advice: recommended daily amount is 5 g (1 teaspoon). Mix in a glass (150 mL) of warm water and drink. Storage: store in a cool and dry place.

Savjeti za uporabu: preporučena dnevna količina je 5 g (1 čajna žličica). Pomiješajte u čaši (150 ml) tople vode i popijte. Način čuvanja: čuvati na hladnom i suhom mjestu.

full.fr: FATBURNTEA,120g - Mélange de thé instantané, guarana et sureau, qui contribue au métabolisme des graisses, élimine l’excès de poids et supprime la sensation de faim.
